question: Does realized future stochastic credit let an already trained ticket body distinguish useful purchase timing in a genuinely continuous life?
starting_checkpoint: The exact frozen ticket native at 8000, across both cohorts, with trainable inherited weights, biases and local writing coefficients and fresh Adam on both arms.

timing_probe.schedule: Freeze 1500 updates per arm from timing and exact initial event parity before any official outcomes. Begin two original arms while the two base-life workers finish. Start the two independent arms afterward, with no more than four heavy workers for these tasks. Target completed training by 11:15 local time and deploy the fixed endpoints by 11:38.

life: An eight-offer uninterrupted body begins with two ordinary true tastes. Each block of four offers uses the same three recurrent objects in random order and one unrelated target. Every fourth offer is preceded by a different actual ordinary distractor contact. Independent base signs cross separate recurring and novel group flips in each geometry, for sixteen lanes per birth and update. Use the same tariffs .05/.25/.55, native sensory and motor selectors, actual ticket cost with sensation, optional paid food taste, and actual harvest as the locked long-life test. Harvest taste is delayed until all eight ledger entries are closed and then physically delivered in order in the surviving body. Prepayment, collection, delays, hidden activity and all local writes stay continuous in both arms, including the delayed tail. Both arms keep differentiation across the entire eight-offer trajectory.
credit: At offer t, initial or distractor actions, the ticket, its edit, and the physical review and edit receive the realized current harvest less actual fee in the current arm. The future arm adds all actual net gains from later offers to those scores. Harvest action receives actual current harvest in both, with later net gains added in the future arm. Edit after the harvest can affect future offers, so the future arm credits only realized later net gains and the current arm uses zero at that decision. All stochastic choices use the realized score-function term, with the same differentiable graph paths in both arms and the same across-geometry leave-one-out baseline by birth and offer. Never discount the rewards or include already paid past fees in a later-score target. Recovery uses same world and float64 if either replica requires it. No evaluation-specific updates inside the frozen test.

single_eval.protocol: Inherited paired known/unseen/unfed single-offer task, weighting these histories 0.5/0.25/0.25. Use the standard 0.05/0.25/0.55 prices for primary means and preserve all original tested prices. Same frozen test geometries for the starting ticket actor and both endpoints.

long_eval: Re-use the sealed 32-offer delayed-taste worlds and original ticket actor trajectories. Both endpoints run naturally, always buy, always pass, and under the same per-life, price-matched and stage-matched purchase quota shuffle regenerated from their own natural trajectories. Score first 2/8/32 and retain actual gross harvest, fees and price-specific purchasing. Compare natural resource, natural minus equal-cost matched scheduling, and natural minus always pass, alongside same-budget future minus current. Both evaluations retain all twelve births and use crossed birth-world uncertainty.
